'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Pete Srodoski DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Pete Srodoski]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Kavanix
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
